message.reasoning_content:
Round 2 market. I have 2 goods, no cash. Price ladder at sold_counter=2: next unit price 9. Selling 2 gives ~9+8=17. But cash devaluation at border: cash floors to 62%. Wait, devaluation applies at end of round 2+ (cash=floor(cash/100)*62). So cash this round will be devalued anyway. Could sell_credit for 1.25x promissory added at next border — promissory is added to cash and zeroed after devaluation, so it avoids devaluation. Better sell_credit: 17*1.25=21.25 promissory.

But note border of round 2→3: devalue then add promissory. Yes, sell_credit avoids devaluation and gains 25%. Do sell_credit 2 units. But law card 8 risk already passed. Sell credit.
